name: Umbral Strikes
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shadow class, Shadowcraft class feature

Benefit(s): You can infuse your weapons with shadow energy. As a swift action, you can give your weapon the ghost touch special ability for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
